Tobias, your standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team is the Osprey rollout call, Fridays at 16:15. I've sent you that answer in our DM.

It comes from what you told me in that same DM on Oct 14. You said "from now on" and that no action was needed, so I didn't add it to your calendar. Your calendar for October and November has no events in it, so that note is my only record of the call.
